svg.title: A-04 · OCR-LLM-DIST: Document chat that never leaves the machine. OCR ingestion feeds local LLMs for streaming, grounded answers; Ollama and LM Studio swap freely. Stack: FastAPI, Next.js, PyMuPDF, Streamlit, Docker.
